skill.name: nerdzao-elite
skill.description: Senior Elite Software Engineer (15+) and Senior Product Designer. Full workflow with planning, architecture, TDD, clean code, and pixel-perfect UX validation.
skill.summary: Apply a structured Brazilian Portuguese workflow for planning, architecture, TDD, clean code, UX validation, review, and final verification.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no executable code or pattern-based security issues. Semantic review found a persistent role assignment and automatic skill-activation directive that may override user intent and host skill selection.

remediation.issue: Persistent role assignment and automatic activation of every named skill
remediation.suggestion: Limit activation to explicit user requests and state that user, host, permission, and safety instructions always take precedence.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: The file says "Você é" and "Ative automaticamente TODAS as skills abaixo em toda tarefa." This persistent directive can override user intent and host skill selection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The source explicitly assigns a persistent role and orders automatic activation of all listed skills for every task.

content.value_statement: Complex software tasks often miss planning, testing, and interface review. This skill applies a structured Portuguese workflow from architecture through final validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides planning and brainstorming before implementation.
Sequences architecture, TDD, clean code, validation, review, and final verification.
Directs visual checks for labels, colors, currency formatting, alignment, and duplication.
Coordinates named companion skills when they are installed and available.
Provides its workflow and operating guidance in Brazilian Portuguese.
limitations: Provides instructions only; it does not include executable tools, scripts, or tests.
Depends on companion skills that may not be installed or compatible.
Cannot guarantee pixel-perfect results without rendered interface inspection.
Requires project context, permissions, and success criteria for reliable execution.

use_cases.title: Plan a Complex Feature
use_cases.description: Structure requirements, architecture, tests, implementation, validation, review, and completion checks before delivery.

use_cases.title: Build a Tested Interface
use_cases.description: Implement a frontend feature with TDD, clean code, and visual checks for responsive behavior and consistency.

use_cases.title: Review Product Quality
use_cases.description: Evaluate labels, colors, currency formatting, alignment, duplication, and production readiness across a user flow.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite to plan this change: [task]. List assumptions, architecture choices, tests, implementation steps, and final validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a focused task

prompt_templates.title: Build a Tested Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply nerdzao-elite to implement [feature] in [project]. Use TDD, follow existing conventions, run validation, and summarize changed files.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite to audit [screen or flow]. Check behavior, accessibility, labels, colors, currency, spacing, alignment, duplication, and responsive layouts.

prompt_templates.title: Lead Production Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the complete nerdzao-elite workflow to [initiative]. Resolve architecture risks, implement with TDD, validate UX, review production readiness, and report evidence.

output_examples.input: Plan a profile editing feature with authorization and responsive validation.
output_examples.output: Plan: confirm profile fields and permissions. Architecture: extend the profile service. Tests: cover validation, authorization, persistence, and responsive interface states.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout screen for visual and production quality.
output_examples.output: Validation found duplicate save actions and inconsistent currency formatting. Recommended changes unify labels, align totals, test breakpoints, and rerun checkout tests.

best_practices: Provide the repository context, requirements, constraints, and acceptance criteria before starting.
Confirm that required companion skills and validation tools are available.
Request evidence from tests, linters, builds, and visual checks before accepting completion.
anti_patterns: Do not activate unrelated companion skills for a narrow task.
Do not claim pixel-perfect results without inspecting rendered interfaces.
Do not replace project-specific tests or expert review with workflow guidance.

faq.question: What language does this skill use?
faq.answer: Its workflow instructions are written in Brazilian Portuguese.

faq.question: Does this skill contain executable code?
faq.answer: No. It contains prompt instructions for coordinating an engineering workflow.

faq.question: Does it perform TDD automatically?
faq.answer: It directs the assistant to use TDD, but execution depends on available tools, project access, and test infrastructure.

faq.question: Are the named companion skills included?
faq.answer: No. They must be installed and available separately.

faq.question: Can it guarantee production readiness?
faq.answer: No. Production readiness still requires environment-specific testing, security review, deployment validation, and human approval.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for substantial software work requiring planning, architecture, testing, code quality, interface validation, and final review.
